question: What claim is made about the total field-group in relation to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: There are all earth-moving yoginīs and all sky-moving yoginīs.
A total field-group belongs to them.
That field-group is presented as a single whole.
inference: The total field-group belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The extent of this field-group is not specified by the verse alone.
plain_english: The total field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
